features.name: Send for signature
features.summary: Add the people who need to sign, mark where each one signs, and send the document from TDPdf.

features.name: Signature requests
features.summary: See where each signature request stands, and download the signed PDF, the certificate of completion and the audit log.

features.name: Sign it yourself
features.summary: When you are the only signer, sign the document yourself and the sealed copy opens back in TDPdf.

features.name: Verify signatures
features.summary: See who signed any PDF, when they signed, and whether anything was added afterwards.

features.name: Compare two PDFs
features.summary: See what changed between two versions of a document: words added or removed, pages added, removed or moved, and areas that look different, side by side or laid over each other.

features.name: Check accessibility
features.summary: See what stops a screen reader using a PDF, such as a missing language or title, untagged text, pictures with no description or a skipped heading level, and fix the simple ones in one click. A list covers what only a person can judge.

features.name: Redaction
features.summary: Remove the text and images under your mark, then check the saved file to make sure nothing is left.

features.name: Edit existing text
features.summary: Pick Edit Text and click a line, or double-click it, then retype it in the same font, size and colour.

features.name: Fill in forms
features.summary: Type into a PDF form's fields, tick its boxes and pick from its lists, then save it.

features.name: Import form data
features.summary: Fill a form from an FDF or XFDF file. Fields are matched by name, the whole import is one undo step, and any names the form does not have are listed.

features.name: Create forms
features.summary: Add text boxes, checkboxes, radio buttons, dropdowns and signature fields to turn any PDF into a form.

features.name: Mark up documents
features.summary: Add text boxes, highlights, freehand ink, shapes and pictures, with your own colour, size and opacity.

features.name: Your saved signature
features.summary: Draw your signature once, or import a picture of it, and place it on any page with one click.

features.name: Signature editor
features.summary: Choose the ink colour and pen width of a drawn signature, clean up a photographed one with a threshold and a soft edge, add today's date under it, and save it as a PNG to use on the signing page.

features.name: Organise pages
features.summary: Merge PDFs, split out pages, and insert, rotate, reorder, extract or delete pages from the sidebar.

features.name: Crop and straighten
features.summary: Crop pages, rotate them by any angle, flip or scale them, and square up a photographed page.

features.name: Search and copy
features.summary: Search the whole document, jump between matches, and select text to copy it out.

features.name: Searchable scans
features.summary: Recognise the text on scanned pages so you can search and copy it, or save a searchable PDF.

features.name: Read EPUB and DjVu books
features.summary: Open an EPUB or DjVu book in its own tab. EPUB books are laid out as pages at the page size and text size you pick, with their pictures, links and contents. DjVu scans keep their pictures, text layer and bookmarks. Save As writes a PDF and the book is never changed.

features.name: Rasterize a region
features.summary: Turn a boxed area of a page into a picture at the resolution you choose, with its text and graphics taken off the page. This is not redaction.

features.name: Merge files
features.summary: Add PDFs and whole folders, drag them into order, and leave out or rearrange individual pages before they are merged into one new document. Form fields, fonts and bookmarks come along.

features.name: Tabs
features.summary: Open several PDFs in one window, each tab keeping track of its own unsaved changes.

features.name: Reading and zoom
features.summary: Read one page at a time or scroll through them all, zoom smoothly, and follow links inside the document.

features.name: Two pages, continuous
features.summary: Scroll through the document with facing pages side by side, with an optional book layout that keeps the cover on its own. Each tab keeps its own view, and the Pages sidebar can show two thumbnails per row.

features.name: Print and flatten
features.summary: Print with your markup included, or flatten every page into a copy that can't be edited.

features.name: Choose the Save Flattened resolution
features.summary: Pick Automatic or 72, 150, 200 or 300 dpi before saving a flattened copy, and see the pixel size each choice gives for the first and the largest page.

features.name: Locked and damaged files
features.summary: Password-protected PDFs ask for the password, and damaged files are repaired when they open.

features.name: Bookmarks
features.summary: Add, rename, nest, reorder and delete bookmarks, and point each one at the right page.

features.name: Measure
features.summary: Drag across a page to measure a distance in inches, millimetres and points at once.

features.name: Smarter Open and Save dialogs
features.summary: Open and Save remember a separate folder for each job, list your recent folders beside Quick Access, show a preview of the PDF you pick, and can open the file in a new window.

features.name: Export pages as images
features.summary: Save pages as PNG or JPEG pictures at the resolution you choose.

features.name: Export as EPUB
features.summary: Turn a PDF into an EPUB book for phones and e-readers. Bookmarks become the table of contents, and headings, lists, tables and pictures are kept. Also available from the command line.

features.name: Move, replace and extract pictures
features.summary: Click a picture on the page to move it, resize it, delete it, copy it, save it as a file, swap in another one, or cut a box or one colour area out of it as a transparent picture.

features.name: Export tables
features.summary: Copy the tables in a PDF into a CSV file that Excel opens.

features.name: Save attached files
features.summary: See the files attached to a PDF with their size, date and description, and save one or all of them. Names are made safe, programs and scripts are flagged before saving, and nothing is ever opened for you.

features.name: Light, dark and night
features.summary: TDPdf follows your Windows theme, with a high contrast theme and a night mode for reading in the dark.

features.name: Keyboard shortcuts
features.summary: Press F1 to see every shortcut on a picture of your own keyboard.

features.name: Install without an administrator
features.summary: Run TDPdf from anywhere, then install it for yourself in seconds with no administrator prompt.

features.name: Deploy with Intune
features.summary: Install silently for every user on a machine, with exit codes and a detection rule ready for Intune.

features.name: Registry policies
features.summary: Set update checks, the signing server and telemetry for every machine through registry policy.

features.name: Telemetry you control
features.summary: Nothing is sent unless your organisation points TDPdf at its own collector, and the privacy policy lists every field.

features.name: Command line
features.summary: Merge, split, flatten, decrypt, print, OCR or convert PDFs to images from a script, with no window.

features.name: Stamps
features.summary: Stamp a page Approved, Draft, Confidential or Final, or with your own words or a picture. Stamps are saved as real stamp annotations, so other PDF viewers show them too.

features.name: Watermarks and page numbers
features.summary: Add a text or picture watermark and page numbers to the pages you choose, with a live preview. Remove them again later from Tools.

features.name: Split view
features.summary: Put two documents side by side in two windows that snap to the halves of your screen, or open the same document twice. The second window of one document is read-only and updates when you save.

features.name: Color management
features.summary: On a monitor with its own color profile, pages show their real colors. In the print window, choose a printer profile and rendering intent, preview how a page will print, and see whether the driver agreed to leave color to TDPdf.

scenarios.name: Fix a contract and get it signed
Share a report with the names removed
Fill in a form and sign it
Turn a photographed page into a searchable PDF
Roll TDPdf out to an organisation
